title: Audit Logger Service
objective: Build a centralised audit-logging service that captures, stores, and indexes security-relevant events across all micro-services, enabling compliance reporting and forensic investigation.

user_stories.i_want: to query audit logs by actor, resource, and time range
user_stories.so_that: I can produce regulatory compliance reports within minutes
I can trust log integrity during forensic investigations

user_stories.i_want: a simple SDK that micro-services can integrate in under 30 minutes
user_stories.so_that: adoption friction is minimised across teams

business_rules.description: Every audit event must include: timestamp, actor_id, action, resource, outcome, and source_service.
Audit records must be append-only — no update or delete operations are permitted.
Events must be retained for a minimum of 7 years to satisfy SOC-2 and GDPR requirements.
PII fields must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 with envelope encryption.

acceptance_criteria.title: Event ingestion
acceptance_criteria.given: A valid audit event payload from a registered micro-service
acceptance_criteria.when: The event is submitted to the /events endpoint
acceptance_criteria.then: The event is persisted and an event_id is returned within 50ms at p99

acceptance_criteria.title: Tamper detection
acceptance_criteria.when: An attempt is made to modify the record directly in the database
acceptance_criteria.then: The integrity check fails and an alert is raised

acceptance_criteria.title: Query by time range
acceptance_criteria.when: A compliance officer queries events for a specific actor within a 24-hour window

non_functional_requirements.description: Ingestion throughput must sustain 10,000 events per second with no data loss
All inter-service communication must use mTLS; the audit service must not log raw credentials or tokens
Zero data loss under single-node failure — replication factor of at least 3

out_of_scope: Real-time alerting on audit events (handled by a separate SIEM integration)
Audit log export to third-party SaaS platforms
